descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Dark Circles✓ Fragrance Free✓ Good for: Loss of firmness✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: An all-in-one, fragrance-free eye serum packed with 12 actives to visibly smooth fine lines, brighten dark circles, reduce puffiness, and increase firmness—made for all skin types.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Oily, and Combination


Skincare Concerns: Fine lines and wrinkles, Dryness, and Redness


Formulation: Liquid


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Alfalfa Extract, White Lupin Protein: Reduces visible puffiness; tones eye area.

- Vitamin K1: Brightens the look of dark circles, prevents visible sagging and fine lines, and soothes.


How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Apply eye serum after face serum, both morning and night.

-For the best experience, dispense product into your hand and apply with your ring finger to the under-eye and browbone areas, tapping gently in an upward motion.

-Allow serum to fully dry down before applying concealer.

Ingredients+

-Suprême Skin Bio-Complex (Exclusive blend of Oligopeptide-1, Peptide Duo, Niacinamide): Jumpstarts skin renewal; smooths the look of fine lines, visibly brightens dark circles, firms complexion. 

-Alfalfa Extract, White Lupin Protein: Reduces visible puffiness; tones eye area.

-Vitamin K1: Brightens the look of dark circles, prevents visible sagging and fine lines, and soothes.


Aqua/Water/Eau, Glycerin, Pentylene Glycol, Glyceryl Stearate, Polyglyceryl-10 Distearate, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Hydrolyzed Lupine Protein, Medicago Sativa (Alfalfa) Seed Extract, Alkanna Tinctoria Root Extract, Ceramide NP, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4, Oligopeptide-1, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Niacinamide, Phytonadione Epoxide, Triolein, Panthenol, Mannitol, Pullulan, Adenosine, Beta-Sitosterol, Glyceryl Caprylate, Glyceryl Dioleate, Polylgyceryl-10 Laurate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Xanthan Gum, Sclerotium Gum, Lecithin, Silica, Sodium Chloride, Dipotassium Phosphate, Potassium Phosphate, Cetyl Alcohol, Phosphatidylcholine, Phenylpropanol, Methylpropanediol, Sorbitan Stearate, Palmitic Acid, Stearic Acid, Polysorbate 80, Decyl Glucoside, 1,2- Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Citric Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate.


The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
